# Vehicle Leasing Associates (UK)

> Qualified vehicle lease consultants based in Exeter, UK, trading as VLA Media Ltd. Vehicle Leasing Associates (UK) is a group of associates whose extensive combined purchasing power secures cost-effective leasing on cars and vans from all mainstream manufacturers — electric, hybrid, petrol or diesel. The business has 17 years of association with one of Europe's leading finance institutions and serves both individuals and businesses.

Every example includes full cover warranty, road tax and no MOT concerns.

## Why lease a new vehicle (vs. keeping an old one)
Older vehicles bring age-related failures, warranty exclusion, outdated technology, low fuel efficiency, frequent repairs and expensive MOTs. Leasing a brand-new vehicle gives fixed monthly payments, no MOT concerns, road tax included, full cover warranty, no depreciation risk and improved economy.

## Electric vehicle focus
The vehicle leasing market is increasingly electric and VLA actively advises on EVs — lower running costs, less maintenance, no tailpipe emissions, instant torque and an easy, quiet drive. See /evs-explained.html. Three of the seven current lease examples are fully electric (Renault 5, Dacia Spring, BYD Atto 2); the rest are hybrid, petrol or diesel.

## Used car & van marketing service
In addition to leasing, VLA offers a used car & van marketing service for vehicles from 15 years old to nearly new. Rather than accepting a low part-exchange valuation, owners use VLA's marketing skills (with the owner's own photos) to advertise the vehicle across major platforms. VLA sends serious, pre-qualified buyers to the owner, who deals with them at their convenience — the goal being to achieve maximum market value. Free, no-obligation consultation.

## Regulatory position (important)
VLA Media Ltd T/A Vehicle Leasing Associates is an **independent introducer only**. It is **not authorised or regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)**, and is **not a lender, finance provider, credit broker or vehicle leasing broker**. It does not carry out regulated activities, does not assess creditworthiness or make lending decisions, and does not give regulated financial advice. VLA facilitates contact between customers and independent third-party FCA-authorised leasing brokers, finance providers or manufacturer dealerships; any finance or leasing agreement is entered into directly between the customer and that third-party provider, subject to their terms, eligibility criteria, credit approval and availability.

VLA Media Ltd may receive a fixed referral fee or commission from a third-party provider where an introduction results in a completed transaction. This is paid by the provider and does not affect the price paid by the customer.

Full text: /disclaimer.html
